notes.note: Memory exhibit captions (all nine events) keep the source's deliberate two-line layout: quoted Memory name, then description. 'Gaia Memory of X' mirrors the franchise's 'memory of X' phrasing.
Gaia Memory voice call rendered in caps and quotes per style (cf. "TRIAL!", "INVISIBLE!!"). Same for all nine Memories.

The faint 'click' only appears for the Memories that fit the G-A-I-A door puzzle (Ice Age = I, Anomalocaris = A); the following door-opening lines are the shared success text that the script branches to.
Ankh, gruff: 'yatta na' read as 'That did it!' (credit to the act, not effusive praise). Identical in all nine events.
Anomalocaris Memory: official name in W; lowercase 'the anomalocaris' in the description as the creature.
Slice ends mid-event; the Yesterday voice call and the rest continue in story_095.

report: 80/80 rows. Repetitive G-A-I-A Memory-puzzle exhibits (events 0525-0533), templated consistently. No glossary gaps beyond Memory names (Cockroach, Nightmare, Energy, Beast, Anomalocaris, Yesterday Memories) which use their official W names.
